still_open: MK-CF-F-133: Unentered investment cash is returned as zero, unlike availableCash’s explicit unknown state. A structural fallback must not become a displayed or spendable cash balance.
MK-CF-F-135: Treats property market value as spendable balance. A $400,000 home is not $400,000 available to settle a purchase without a sale.
MK-CF-F-136: Investment cash can be initialized from a missing amount; updates must preserve unknown cash and linked/derived total conventions.
MK-CF-F-138: Adds shares/cost correctly, but a missing date cannot become a known acquisition date and ticker classification is delegated without a fully supplied mapping.
MK-CF-F-139: FIFO order is stated correctly, including undated lots last, but excess removals and a lot with unknown quantity have no explicit refusal/allocation contract.

MK-CF-F-111: Its broad transaction contract contains unresolved paths: sale without shares lowers balance although a sale is internal cash conversion, and unknown existing quantities allow a sale to stand without a specified residual position.
MK-CF-F-222: Explicitly changes missing cash as if it were zero, creating an invented balance even though applyTransaction promises missing cash stays unentered.

MK-CF-F-223: Known holdings use the correct multiplier, but a newly bought option has no holding and falls back to 1. The recorded limitation undercounts a new option trade unless type is acquired upstream.

scope: Written formulas,owner decisions and primary publications only. No repository code,existingtests or liveapp outputs were inspected for this review. Attached screen-register worked/app-result fields were excluded from expected-answer derivation.

formula_checks.name: map
formula_checks.why: Applies the transformation only to the named account and preserves other accounts/order.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: cashOf
formula_checks.why: Unentered investment cash is returned as zero, unlike availableCash’s explicit unknown state. A structural fallback must not become a displayed or spendable cash balance.
formula_checks.should_be: Return unknown/entered metadata or restrict this helper to nonfinancial structural accumulation.
formula_checks.rests_on: DEC-3279e as cited in F-135; tenet 3

formula_checks.name: usesSleeve
formula_checks.why: Identifies the storage location of investment cash; this does not authorize treating property market value as spendable cash.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: availableCash
formula_checks.why: Treats property market value as spendable balance. A $400,000 home is not $400,000 available to settle a purchase without a sale.
formula_checks.should_be: Restrict immediately spendable cash to actual cash accounts and known investment cash sleeves; property requires a dated sale/financing event.

formula_checks.name: bumpCash
formula_checks.why: Investment cash can be initialized from a missing amount; updates must preserve unknown cash and linked/derived total conventions.
formula_checks.should_be: If cash is unknown, keep it unknown or require a confirmed opening amount; preserve typed, derived and broker totals as declared.

formula_checks.name: findPos
formula_checks.why: Uses stable holding id before ticker. Multiple holdings with the same ticker require unique-id resolution upstream.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: addLot
formula_checks.why: Adds shares/cost correctly, but a missing date cannot become a known acquisition date and ticker classification is delegated without a fully supplied mapping.
formula_checks.should_be: Preserve absent date/cost and classification uncertainty; never overwrite an explicit classification.

formula_checks.name: removeShares
formula_checks.why: FIFO order is stated correctly, including undated lots last, but excess removals and a lot with unknown quantity have no explicit refusal/allocation contract.
formula_checks.should_be: Do not erase unknown shares or oversell; require enough recorded quantity or retain an unresolved sale.

formula_checks.name: applyTransaction
formula_checks.why: Its broad transaction contract contains unresolved paths: sale without shares lowers balance although a sale is internal cash conversion, and unknown existing quantities allow a sale to stand without a specified residual position.
formula_checks.should_be: Define amount-only sales and unknown-lot sales explicitly; preserve cash unknowns and total-asset conservation, with fees applied once.

formula_checks.name: tradeCash
formula_checks.why: Explicitly changes missing cash as if it were zero, creating an invented balance even though applyTransaction promises missing cash stays unentered.
formula_checks.should_be: Preserve unknown cash; update only entered cash and the applicable typed fee effect.
formula_checks.rests_on: DEC-3279e as cited by F-135; DEC-7595; tenet 3

formula_checks.name: tradeMultiplierOf
formula_checks.why: Known holdings use the correct multiplier, but a newly bought option has no holding and falls back to 1. The recorded limitation undercounts a new option trade unless type is acquired upstream.
formula_checks.should_be: Require instrument type/multiplier when opening a new position, or refuse an unclassified contract trade; preserve historical ×1 records.

formula_checks.name: openingRecordsOf
formula_checks.why: One opening record per purchase retains quantity, date, and known basis without fabricating a zero basis.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: makeTransaction
formula_checks.why: Preserves supplied economic data while adding a unique id/time and canonical ticker; deterministic id/time cannot be asserted, only their properties.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: affectedAccountIds
formula_checks.why: Identifies primary and optional receiving accounts; consumers must treat identities as a set to avoid double mutation.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic
